In 2020, Amish Mody realized that finding chemical-free food shouldn't be a luxury. With zero experience and just one weighing scale, he started delivering fresh produce out of his car. Today, his Organik Truck, powered by his reliable Tata Ace Gold, bypasses middlemen entirely, bringing farm-fresh harvests from over 1,000 farmers directly to city neighbourhoods. Here's how one man built a system rooted in complete transparency. People like Amish prove that a single citizen's vision can transform an entire system, kyunki Bharat Humse Aage Badhta Hai.
